verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents an observability section covering performance monitoring (execution times, token usage, resource consumption) and GitHub explicitly claims 'Tracing & Observability: Monitor and track your AI agents and workflows in real-time, including metrics, logs, and traces,' plus enterprise AMP claims real-time monitoring of deployed crews. However, evidence doesn't detail a first-party UI screen showing per-call LLM/tool trace granularity, nor any hands-on/independent confirmation of the tracing UI in practice. missing for 10: concrete UI screenshots/walkthrough of per-call tracing, independent/hands-on verification that every LLM call and tool invocation is visible in the UI.
